Thanks again for the intro — excited to get Orion Consulting into the Redwood Integrator program. To set expectations for the first two engagements I'd like to run a short Integrator Readiness Brief this month followed by a hands-on enablement lab and a 3-week POC cadence. High level agenda:

- 60m: Technical kickoff (API, auth, common integration patterns)
